messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-9247 -> inference-high-99th-latency. Trigger: p95>750ms for 3m in us-west-2 (redwood-prod). Pager URL: https://pagerduty.example/INC-9247 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Escalation to alex (oncall) — notification sent.
alex (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Brief status: seeing increased tail latency on text-generation endpoints.
maria (sre): on standby. tagging jamal from runtime because this smells like KV cache pressure.
jamal (eng-runtime): joining. grabbing recent traces from honeycomb and the per-route latency shard. running `curl https://console.redwood/inference/metrics?range=15m` to pull quick numbers.
alex (oncall): Quick note to customers: support team notified, setting status page draft. sam (product) can you confirm any large customer jobs?
sam (product): I don't see scheduled heavy jobs. A single partner had a spike yesterday but nothing queued now.
jen-support: Customer-reported slowdown ticket INC-5543 linked to this page. Customer sees timeouts on /v1/chat stream. They reported partial responses.
jamal (eng-runtime): logs: ``ERROR: kv_cache_miss flood: client=pool-7 size=1.6GB rate=430/s`` — looks like cache eviction storm. Also seeing GC churn on host gpu-07.
maria (sre): Are we hitting autoscale? check dedicated pools and fallback policy.
alex (oncall): Autoscale shows no new nodes launched in last 10m. config: `min_replicas=3, max_replicas=10`. current_replicas=3.
jamal (eng-runtime): I pushed a temporary routing rule to divert non-prod traffic and low-priority customers to a cheaper quantized model variant. command: `redwoodctl routing create --match=customer_tier:free --route=model:rw-small-8q`
alex (oncall): Confirmed lower-priority traffic reduced by ~28% concurrent. tail latency p95 down from ~1.2s to ~830ms.
maria (sre): Suggest increasing `max_replicas` to 12 for the pool and trigger scale-up while we investigate root cause. Can someone approve change?
jamal (eng-runtime): I'll open a hotpatch PR to bump autoscale and adjust eviction thresholds. PR: https://git.example/rw/runtime/pulls/3824
alex (oncall): Go ahead jamal. I'll monitor.
jen-support: Notifying impacted customers: drafting message — "We're investigating increased response times for text-generation in us-west-2. We're implementing mitigations now."
sam (product): Keep the message conservative, no RCA yet. Offer ETA: 30m.
jamal (eng-runtime): Hotpatch applied. Scale request injected, cluster shows pending new pods 4 -> provisioning. Also raised KV cache threshold from 1.2GB -> 2.0GB.
maria (sre): Observability: span durations in honeycomb show a spike in `kv_store.fetch()` latency correlating with GC events. Likely memory pressure causing extra network fetches.
alex (oncall): p95 is now 320ms, p99 ~780ms. Halfway.
jen-support: Customer INC-5543 updated: "We see improvement but occasional timeouts persist."
jamal (eng-runtime): I'm rolling a safe config to increase model shard cache persistence and disable aggressive eviction for 15m: `runtime.config.cache_eviction_policy=staggered`
maria (sre): Can we keep retention of logs for this incident. tagging incident runbook: https://confluence.example/incidents/runbooks/inference-latency
alex (oncall): Noting action items: 1) jamal: follow-up hotpatch and postmortem notes, 2) maria: evaluate root cause (GC vs workload), 3) support/jen: customer comms, 4) sam: any contractual SLA touchpoints.
sam (product): I can lead the customer liaison if needed.
jamal (eng-runtime): New pods up. p95 stabilized ~180ms, p99 ~300ms. KV miss rate down 92%.
jen-support: Updated customers: improvement confirmed. Will keep message open for 1hr then close if stable.
maria (sre): I'll start a timeline and collect heap dumps from gpu-07 and push to shared bucket: `gs://redwood-incident/INC-9247/heapdumps/`.
alex (oncall): Thanks all. handing off to maria for post-incident and detailed RCA. I'll drop out of the loop in 30m. If anything regresses, ping oncall.
incident-bot: Incident INC-9247 status -> acknowledged -> mitigated -> assigned_to: maria (sre). Logs archived at https://logs.example/INC-9247.
maria (sre): Taking ownership for RCA and postmortem. Will post initial timeline in ~4 hours.
jamal (eng-runtime): Follow-up note: we should look at cache sizing defaults for models with long context windows. I'll include suggested config changes in the PR. :memo:
alex (oncall): Closing active paging thread from my side. If anybody needs me, ping DM. :white_check_mark:
